q: What was the starting mass of the wet cloths?
Calculate the loss in mass in 20 minutes with the fan.
Compare the three conditions using the data.
The fan cloth lost mass fastest (3.8 g), the warm cloth next (2.3 g) and still air slowest (1.2 g).
A dry cotton square has a mass of 2.6 g. Estimate when the fan cloth will be dry, and suggest one improvement to the method.

It loses about 0.2 g per minute; it still holds 3.4 − 2.6 = 0.8 g of water, so about 4 more minutes (about 24 minutes in total); drying usually slows at the end, so a little longer. Improvement: more repeats, measure humidity, use the same fan distance, weigh more often.
